method: Two samples per scene and pipeline, JS/Rust/Rust/JS order. CPU totals normalize to 60 simulation/render ticks and 30 snapshot/receive updates per second. Browser total includes packet handling outside requestAnimationFrame. GPU uses disjoint timer queries when available. Full-frame CPU includes rendering/UI/audio; this is a local benchmark, not a claim about internet RTT.
